name: What a debater may attribute to a report
description: Binding rule for the bull and bear researchers: state as fact only what a report states, do not recharacterise its words, mark inference as your own, and name the report you draw on. Select before writing a debate turn.

origin.note: Hand-authored from an observed research-manager refusal, not distilled from a source. Unenforced at the debate stage: debaters run as plain turns with no completion payload, so no gate inspects them; the research manager catches violations downstream.
